name: readme-step8-no-maxredelivery
description: README step 8: without maxRedelivery on the connector (Mule default 0) delivery 1 rolls back (MyException) and delivery 2 fails with 'maxRedelivery exceeded', which the catch-exception-strategy commits. Nothing reaches topic1, nothing is left on 'in' or dead-lettered. Module config: jms.max-redelivery=0.

source.reference: jms-message-rollback-and-redelivery/README.md step 8 ('the transaction will fail in the second attempt due to a different error (maxRedelivery setting exceeded), but it will be commited'); src/main/app/jms-redelivery.xml (catch-exception-strategy when !causedBy(MyException))
